code_note: Pre-fix code: made with SetuHQ (then called exoplan) up to commit 5a03087, before two fixes that change default results: preprocess.clean no longer deletes dips deeper than 10 times the point-to-point scatter, and vet.py's odd/even test no longer fails clean deep planets. Not re-run: its Sentinel rates cannot be measured again without calling the Sentinels, and the weights are a frozen parameter of the benchmark protocol (see current_code in this file).
source: Per-reviewer rates printed by 'exoplan calibrate' when it wrote reviewer_weights_full_panel.json on 2026-10-16, with the code of commit 03f23bd (the commit that added the weights): n = 10 injected and 10 empty subjects per reviewer, seed 0.
current_code: The Probes' rates do not reproduce on later code: since commit fbc1ed9 (2026-10-19) the injected transits are limb-darkened, not trapezoids, and the same calibration (seed 0, 10 + 10 subjects) gives TPR 0.9, 0.8 and 0.6 (FPR 0) for volunteer-sensitive, volunteer-typical and volunteer-cautious, on 5a03087 and on the current code alike. The weights stay frozen: they are a parameter of the benchmark protocol. With three Probes, min_score = 0.5 and min_planet_fraction = 0.5, both weight sets accept exactly the dips at least two of the three Probes mark (tests/test_calibration_equivalence.py), so every consensus decision is the same.
